purpose: Use newly idle authorized GPU 6 after accelerator-r01 completion to execute eight already-preregistered, currently unstarted phase-1 jobs ahead of their original shards.

scheduling.selection_rule: Select four paired TargetDiff/DiffSBDD logical cells that had no source state at the 05:40 checkpoint and do not overlap accelerator-r01 or accelerator-r02.
scheduling.duplicate_guard: Abort before launch if GPU 6 has a compute process or any selected source state directory exists; the source queue also skips a tag carrying a live PID or terminal exit code.

claim_limits: This run changes wall-clock scheduling only and contributes no independent scientific condition.
All outputs remain part of the source r02 phase-1 matrix and are counted once by logical job tag.
Any nonzero exit remains preserved and receives coverage only through a fresh exact-retry run.
